findingClass: the pull walk re-asks fields and REWRITES them with identical values, which is indistinguishable in every downstream reading from the walk confirming them -- a healthy-looking write rate that is entirely no-op churn, and the field_sources provenance trail it produces is noise that hides the one real change in it
githubIssue: UNFILED (item 6, design §2.5.2). Built (item 10, OD-42): scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs carries record('pull_noop_suppression', ...) (checkS_pullNoopSuppression), invoked from main().
failThreshold: RECOMMENDED, NOT MEASURED: on a data-job cycle with no newly-filed documents and no genuine source disagreement, (field_sources rows written this cycle) / (ipo_field_plan rows re-asked this cycle) stays under 5%. The 5% is a starting value stated as a recommendation per OD-18's 'no number typed from memory' -- the check's own first weeks of output are what should replace it with a measured threshold. Until then a number here would be a guess wearing a threshold's clothes. Implemented as WARN, not FAIL, above the ceiling (scripts/lib/pull-noop-suppression-checks.mjs).
unverifiableWhen: no data-job cycle ran since the previous audit, OR ENABLE_FIELD_PLAN_WALK is off in the slot being audited (there is nothing to measure, and a zero ratio from a walk that never ran must never read as a pass), OR ipo_field_plan holds no rows for the window
prerequisite: item 15 (`valueActuallyChanged` deciding a write on its own) MUST be live, and it is: data-consolidation-service.ts carries `valueActuallyChanged` with the NoopSuppressionCounts four-way split, whose `writtenSameSourceChanged` counts the cases where it ALONE decided the write. Without that split, a healthy PULL-NOOP ratio and a `valueActuallyChanged` that has never once decided anything look identical -- which is the exact indistinguishability this check exists to break.
